newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia hopes to sign London Club pact by end-June.
newsitem.headline: Russia hopes to sign London Club pact by end-June.

text.p: Russia plans to sign an agreement rescheduling debt of the former Soviet Union with the London Club of bank creditors by June 30, a senior Finance Ministry official said on Wednesday.
"In June we are planning to sign an agreement on our debt restructuring," Foreign Debt Department Head Alexei Smirnov told Reuters.
By that time Russia plans to reconcile the $20 billion necessary to close the deal. It will take until August to agree on interest payments to each individual bank, Smirnov said.
